faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.sub: Can't find your answer? Write to hello@deutli.com.
faq.1.q: Which exams does this prepare me for?
faq.1.a: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 and telc Deutsch B1. Both test reading, listening, writing and speaking, and our mock exams follow their formats and timing. We are not affiliated with Goethe-Institut or telc.
faq.2.q: What level do I need to start?
faq.2.a: You should have finished A2 or be close to it. Start with the free plan and see how the first module feels.
faq.3.a: The AI marks mistakes fast and explains them, but it can be wrong. That's why on Pro a teacher reviews your homework and writing and confirms or corrects every mark. You always see both.
faq.4.a: Teacher reviews and questions are answered within 24 hours.
faq.5.q: Can I use Deutli in Urdu?
faq.5.a: Yes. Grammar explanations, mistake feedback and vocabulary come with English and Urdu support.
faq.6.q: How can I pay from Pakistan?
faq.6.a: You can pay in PKR by debit or credit card, JazzCash or Easypaisa. International students can pay in EUR by card.
faq.7.a: Yes. Cancel in two clicks from your account, and email us within 14 days of paying for a full refund.
